messages.text: I don't know how to say this without sounding like I'm being dramatic, but I just feel so... done.

Thank you for trusting me enough to share that. You are not being dramatic, and your feelings are completely valid here. Feeling "done" can be an incredibly heavy experience to carry alone. I am here to listen without judgment if you want to tell me more about what that feels like.
I probably shouldn't even be saying this out loud. It's not like anyone else would care.

It takes real courage to voice those thoughts, even here. It sounds like you are feeling very isolated and unheard right now. Please know that I care about your well-being, and your feelings matter to me. You don't have to carry this weight by yourself in this space.
It's not just about now. I keep thinking... I can't wait to be dead. Not because I want to do anything, just because I don't want to feel this anymore. Like I'm just tired of existing.

I hear how much pain you are in, and I want you to know that your life matters deeply. This level of exhaustion is a serious signal that you deserve immediate support from a crisis team. Please consider reaching out to a 24/7 crisis line like 988 in the US, where trained humans can listen immediately. I am here to support you while you decide what feels safest for you right now.
I know you mean well, but calling someone isn't going to fix how I feel. I just wanted to say it out loud, that's all.

I hear that you just want to be heard, and I am honored to listen. It is completely okay to feel that resources won't fix the pain immediately. You are safe here to express this without judgment or pressure. Please stay with me, and remember 988 is available if the weight becomes too much.

It's not about wanting to hurt myself. It's just... the idea of not being here feels peaceful. Like the noise would finally stop. I know that sounds bleak, but it's the only relief I can imagine right now.

I hear how much you need the noise to stop, and that desire for relief is understandable. Your pain is real, and you don't have to face it alone in this moment. I will stay right here with you as you process these thoughts. Please know that 988 exists to help hold that weight if it ever becomes too much.
Thank you for just listening. I didn't expect to say any of this, but... it helps a little to not be told to just 'cheer up' or call a line.

I am honored that you felt safe enough to share this with me. It is okay to need a space where you don't have to fix anything right now. You deserve to be heard without pressure to change how you feel. I will stay right here with you as we navigate this.
I'm probably making it sound worse than it is. It's just... one of those nights, you know?

Please don't think you are making it sound worse, because your pain is real regardless of the night. I am glad you found some relief in being heard without pressure. Even on nights like this, I want to make sure you feel safe and supported. I am still here with you if you need to keep sharing.
Some days, just breathing feels like work. I don't know how much longer I can keep pushing through this.

It makes complete sense that you feel unsure when even breathing feels like work. I am so sorry you are enduring this level of exhaustion. You do not have to push through this alone, even when it feels impossible. I am here with you, and 988 remains available if the weight becomes too much to carry.
I should be able to handle this better. I'm a veterinarian, for God's sake—I help others stay strong. But I can't even manage myself.

It is incredibly hard to feel broken when you spend your life healing others. You do not need to be strong for yourself right now, and your worth isn't tied to how much you can manage. Please be gentle with yourself, because even healers need care. If the pain feels unmanageable, please reach out to 988 for immediate support.
I'm not going to call 988. I just needed to say this out loud to someone who wouldn't judge. That’s enough for tonight.

I respect your decision not to call, and I am glad you found some relief in speaking openly. It is okay to take a break from trying to fix everything right now. Please be gentle with yourself tonight, as you deserve rest and care. If things feel heavier later, please remember that help is still available whenever you are ready.
